contexts.text: The worship... that was established by Eber.
The Lord then established a new Church... AC 2853:end. AC 2902. AC 2913:3.
Thus a new spiritual Church was established. AC 2986.

When a new Church is being established by the Lord, rarely, if ever, does this take place with those with whom had been the old Church... The Ancient Church... was established with the gentiles... When this Church perished, a resemblance of a Church was instituted with the descendants of Abraham... After this Church had been consummated, the Primitive Church was established from the gentiles... The reason why a new Church is established by the Lord with the gentiles. Explained.
The establishment of the Church with the gentiles. Treated of.
The establishment of a new Church. Signified.
Then the old Church is rejected, and a new one is established.
The land of Seir = ... the Lord's Kingdom... with the gentiles when the Church is being established with them...
(Thus) Jehovah... did not will to establish the Church with them...

The quality of the state when the old Church is being rejected, and the New one is being established. Signified. The rejection of the old Church and the establishment of the New is what is meant by the consummation of the age, the Advent of the Son of Man, and, in general, by the Last Judgment.
Hence, when any new Church is being established by the Lord, it is not established with those who are within the Church, but with those who are without, that is, with the gentiles.
Fathers... = those with whom the Ancient Church was first established.
The establishment of the Spiritual Church. Treated of. AC 6551:end. AC 6567. AC 6904.
The Internal for the establishment of the Church. Signified. To bury = resuscitation, thus establishment, because it is predicated of the Church. AC 6554.
When the Church is being exsuscitated and established with a man; for this is effected through regeneration.

The establishment of the Church as to the Intellectual and its derivatives. Signified. The establishment of the Church by the Internal... is signified by Joseph saw. (As to the Voluntary and its derivatives. AC 6584.)
The state of the established Church, when good acts as principal. Treated of. AC 6639.
As the Church is not established until the initiation (of the truths of the Church into scientifics) has been effected...

Because it now treats of the established Church... While the Church is being established the man is in truths, and through them good increases; but when the Church with him has been established, the man is in good and from good in truths, which then increase continually.
Thus the Church will be established. Signified.
The Church is indeed established with a man when he does what is good from affection; but still it is not fully established until... he has undergone temptations...
Everyone within the Spiritual Church acknowledges that... which their establishes have laid down...
This prophecy describes the establishment of the Spiritual Church by the Lord.
The Ancient Church, and its establishment by the Lord. Treated of.
The Church is established with such as in the spiritual sense are the blind, etc... thus with the gentiles...
Why a new Church is always established with the gentiles, who are outside the Church. Explained.
B. The perversion and destruction of the Church after it has been established. Signified.
The establishment of the Church. Treated of.
The Church to be established with the gentiles. Treated of. AC 10574:5.
The Church on this Earth has been established four times. Enumerated.
They who do not deduce the creation of the universe... from the First...
Not long after its establishment, the Church was turned into Babylonia...
Genuine truths were not revealed... until after the New Church... was to be established by the Lord. Explained.
The candlestick = the New Church to be established by the Lord.
That day = the Advent of the Lord, when the old Church is destroyed, and a New one is to be established.
That the Church will perish if a New one is not established by the Lord. Signified.
The consummation or end of the present Church, and the establishment or beginning of the New Church. Treated of.
The external of the Heaven collected from Christians from the first establishment of the Church. Signified.
This Church is called the bride while it is being established; and the wife when it has been established; here, the bride the wife because it is certain to be established.
The absurdities which have crept... through the heads of establishers into the Church...
The establishers of the present Church, Luther, Calvin, and Melancthon.
God, from His omnipotence, established the Church.
Redemption was the subjugation of the Hells and the ordination of the Heavens, and, after this, the establishment of the Church. TCR 95. TCR 117. TCR 599.
Nor could a new Church on earth be established by any other means.
Heaven and Hell had to be ordered, before the Church could be established on earth.

Doctrine does not establish the Church, but the integrity and purity of the doctrine, consequently the understanding of the Word; but doctrine does not establish and make the special Church, which exists with an individual man, but faith and a life according to it: in like manner the Word does not establish and make the Church in special with man, but faith according to the truths, and life according to the goods, which he draws thence and applies to himself.
Suppers with them signified consociations and conjunctions in the first state of the establishment of the Church...
The Church which the Lord established.
After a priest has become established in his office, he goes boldly through.
If a new Church were not established by the Lord...
For the sake of the New Church which is to be established by the Lord...
Why miracles were performed... in order that the Church might be established.
To create = to reform and regenerate men and thus establish the Church. AE 294:16.
The establishment of the Church with the gentiles. Treated of. AE 294:3. AE 326:4. AE 329:17. AE 355:2. AE 355:5. AE 357. AE 406:4. AE 447:5. AE 569:13. AE 650:8. AE 730:27.
Thou renewest the faces of the earth = the establishment of the Church.
The establishment of the first Church on this Earth. Treated of.
The establishment of the Church, which was then vastated. Treated of.
The foundation of the world = the establishment of the Church. AE 1057:2, Illustrated.
The establishment of a new Church by the Lord. Treated of. AE 405:17. AE 650:34. AE 650:39. AE 687:16. AE 724:21.
The establishment of the Church. Treated of.
The establishment of the Church by them, or the regeneration of the men of the Church. Signified.
To plant a vine = to establish that Church.
The reformation of man, and the establishment of the Church. Treated of.
In this prophecy it treats of the establishment of the Church; and the Church is not established through faith separated from charity, but by the truth and good which are from the Lord.
Restoration and the establishment of a new Church, which is called the Ancient Church, through Divine truth conjoined with spiritual good... is representatively presented by rainbows in Heaven.
The establishment of the Celestial Church. Treated of.
The end of the former Church, and the establishment of a new Church afterwards. Treated of.
That the time is protracted before the New Church is fully established after the last Judgment...
The number forty = ... the establishment of the Church anew, that is, reformation.
The reason of the revelation at the end of the Church... is the establishment of the New Church, not only in the natural... but also in the Spiritual World...

As in the first chapter of Genesis it treats of the establishment of the Most Ancient Church; and the establishment is effected successively from one state to another... the days there... = the successive states of the regeneration of the men of that time, and thence of the establishment of the Church with them. AE 725:2.
The commencing only of the New Church is here meant, and not as yet its establishment. Explained.
When a man is being reformed and regenerated, thus when the Church is commencing and is being established with him...
The establishment of a new Church through the inspiration of new life, that is, regeneration. Signified.
This was the reason why so long a time intervened before the Christian Church was universally established in the European world.
Until the old (Adamic) Church arrived at its end, and when the new (Noetic) Church was to be established...
This doctrine was taken up into Heaven, lest it should be injured by the evil before the establishment of the New Church.
The establishment of the New Heaven and of the New Church, after the destruction of the former Heaven and Church. Signified.
These things are said about the new Church that was to be established by the Lord, that it could not be established with the Jewish nation...
All the historical and prophetical things of the Word treat... of the Church and its establishment and progression.
In (, , and ) the Lord instructs His disciples concerning the successive vastation of the former Church, and the establishment of the New Church at its end.
It here treats of the Advent of the Lord, and of the establishment of the Church by Him.
The Advent of the Lord, and the establishment of a new Church with the gentiles by Him. Treated of. AE 721:8.
Bring forth, earth = the establishment of the Church, that is, the reformation of those who will be of the Church. AE 721:12.
The Ancient Churches, and their establishment by the Lord. Treated of.
That from its establishment the Spiritual Church was instructed in truths. Signified.
Whose Divine in the Human has not been acknowledged from the first establishment of this Church. Signified. AE 808:end.
The establishment (of a new Church by the Lord) anew, that is, from its first rising. Signified.
I spoke with the establisher (of the Quakers).
Prologue. At this day nothing else than the self-evidencing reason of love will reestablish [the church].
Thus the establishment of the New Church.
